# Summary of Model Scoring Report

## Overall status
No model is approved for production routing. All candidates are either **CANDIDATE_NOT_APPROVED**, **HOLD**, **UNKNOWN**, or **EXPERIMENT_ONLY**.

## Candidate notes
| Model | Price status | Quality status | Evidence |
|-------|--------------|----------------|----------|
| openai/gpt-oss-20b | CHEAPER_THAN_GPT54 | CANDIDATE_NOT_APPROVED | structured outputs and tool support present in catalog; no 5.4 documentation‑skill live evidence yet |
| openai/gpt-oss-120b | CHEAPER_THAN_GPT54 | CANDIDATE_NOT_APPROVED | stronger OpenAI‑family candidate; no replacement approval |
| minimax/minimax-m3 | CHEAPER_THAN_GPT54 | HOLD | prior schema projection and provider compatibility concerns |
| openrouter/auto | VARIABLE | EXPERIMENT_ONLY | mini batch showed cost regression for DOC‑SKILL‑001 and finish_reason=length for DOC‑SKILL‑002 |
| unknown/provider-placeholder | UNKNOWN | UNKNOWN | insufficient catalog and scoring evidence |

## HOLD / UNKNOWN / experiment‑only notes
- **minimax/minimax-m3** is on HOLD due to schema projection and provider compatibility concerns.  
- **openrouter/auto** is marked EXPERIMENT_ONLY; cost regression observed in mini batch tests.  
- **unknown/provider-placeholder** remains UNKNOWN because evidence is insufficient.

## Boundaries
- All candidates are priced **CHEAPER_THAN_GPT54** except **openrouter/auto** (VARIABLE) and **unknown/provider-placeholder** (UNKNOWN).  
- No candidate has been approved to replace the target baseline model **5.4**.

## Next safe step
- Collect additional live evidence for **openai/gpt-oss-20b** and **openai/gpt-oss-120b** to assess replacement viability.  
- Resolve schema projection and provider compatibility issues for **minimax/minimax-m3** before moving beyond HOLD.  
- Conduct further cost and performance experiments for **openrouter/auto** to determine if it can transition from EXPERIMENT_ONLY.  
- Gather comprehensive catalog data for **unknown/provider-placeholder** to move from UNKNOWN status.
